# SvgDocumentExport

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A rendered SVG document: one standalone SVG string per page, plus `@font-face` CSS that embeds (as subsetted data URIs) the fonts the document used, so a host can render the pages with the exact fonts BonniePDF laid them out with.

The export is plain data, so `JSON.stringify(result)` is its JSON form: the value a host sends to a previewer in another process, or that a .NET server produces for the same document. Keep every part of it free of class instances and methods.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`fontFaceCss`](#fontfacecss): `<style>`-ready `@font-face` rules, or `''` when the document uses no embeddable fonts (e.g. only the viewer-supplied standard-14).
- [`pages`](#pages): One standalone `<svg>` document per page, in page order.
- [`report`](#report): The compliance report for `snapshot`, present exactly when the snapshot is.
- [`snapshot`](#snapshot): The captured layout tree, present only when `SvgPageExportOptions.captureLayout` was set.
- [`version`](#version): Export format version; see `SVG_DOCUMENT_EXPORT_VERSION`.

### `fontFaceCss`

```typescript
fontFaceCss: string
```

`<style>`-ready `@font-face` rules, or `''` when the document uses no embeddable fonts (e.g. only the viewer-supplied standard-14).

### `pages`

```typescript
pages: string[]
```

One standalone `<svg>` document per page, in page order. Each root carries `width`, `height` and `viewBox` in PDF points.

> A list you can change.

### `report`

```typescript
report?: ComplianceReport | undefined
```

*optional*

The compliance report for `snapshot`, present exactly when the snapshot is. Equal to `evaluateCompliance(snapshot)` with default options, so every rule family runs, WCAG included; filter by `standard` to hide one. Attached here so the report always comes from the same engine as the snapshot it describes, even when it is read in another process.

### `snapshot`

```typescript
snapshot?: LayoutSnapshot | undefined
```

*optional*

The captured layout tree, present only when [`SvgPageExportOptions.captureLayout`](svg-page-export-options.md#capturelayout) was set. Its `pages`/rectangles are index-aligned with `pages` and use the same top-left, points coordinate space as the SVG.

### `version`

```typescript
version: number
```

Export format version; see [`SVG_DOCUMENT_EXPORT_VERSION`](svg-document-export-version.md).
